key_idea: Pure simulation: normalise confusable letters, map each character to its base-27 digit, verify the weighted checksum and convert the first eight digits to decimal.
sketch: Apply the substitution table (B->8, G->C, I->1, O->0, Q->0, S->5, U->V, Y->V, Z->2) to all nine characters including the check digit, then look each one up in the alphabet 0123456789ACDEFHJKLMNPRTVWX. Compute (2,4,5,7,8,10,11,13)-weighted sum of the first eight digits mod 27 and compare with the ninth digit. Print Invalid on mismatch, else the base-27 value of the first eight digits, which is up to 27^8 ~ 2.8e11 and needs 64-bit.
